metadata.title: EVACORE - Shelter Capacity Live-Tracker
metadata.description: Real-time shelter capacity tracking and relief voucher system for disaster management. Find available shelters, register evacuees, and distribute relief vouchers.

common.geoNotSupported: Geolocation is not supported by your browser.

dashboard.title: Live Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Real-time shelter capacity across the region - click a marker for details.

hospitals.title: Nearby Hospitals
hospitals.noHospitals: No medical centers found in this area.

shelterForm.title: Register Shelter
shelterForm.subtitle: Add your shelter or relief camp to the live map. New registrations require admin approval before they become visible to evacuees.
shelterForm.infoNote: Your shelter will appear as pending until a district admin approves it. Occupancy updates can be made from your coordinator dashboard after approval.
shelterForm.name: Shelter Name
shelterForm.geoDenied: Location permission denied. Please enter coordinates manually.
shelterForm.geoFailed: Could not detect location. Please enter coordinates manually.
shelterForm.success: Shelter registered! It will appear on the map once approved.
shelterForm.failed: Failed to register shelter. Please try again.

errors.capacityPositive: Capacity must be a positive number.

evacueeForm.title: Register Evacuee
evacueeForm.subtitle: Register yourself or someone in need. You can describe the situation in your own words and our AI will fill the form - or fill it in manually.
evacueeForm.infoNote: After registration, you'll be matched to the nearest shelter with available space. If all shelters are full, a relief voucher with a QR code will be generated automatically.
evacueeForm.aiIntakeSubtitle: Describe your situation in any language - AI will fill the form for you.
evacueeForm.aiPlaceholder: e.g. "Mera parivar 5 log hai, hum Salt Lake phase 3 ke paas hai, ek boodha aadmi ko wheelchair chahiye"
evacueeForm.missingHint: If a family member is separated, enter their name for reunification matching.
evacueeForm.geoFailed: Could not detect location. Enter manually.
evacueeForm.voiceNotSupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser.
evacueeForm.typeOrSpeak: Type or speak a description first.
evacueeForm.couldNotAutofill: Couldn't auto-fill - please fill the form manually.
evacueeForm.aiExtracted: AI extracted details - please review before submitting.
evacueeForm.voiceConfirmation: Registration confirmed. You have been assigned to {shelterName}, approximately {distanceKm} kilometers away.
evacueeForm.voiceVoucherConfirmation: Registration confirmed. Regional shelters are full. An official emergency ration voucher pass has been generated on your screen.

errors.familySizeMin: Family size must be at least 1.

voucher.invalidDefaultMsg: This voucher code is invalid or has lapsed.
voucher.previewSubtitle: Generated relief voucher assigned to an evacuee when shelter capacity is full.
